tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: US-listed tickers, one per line, e.g. AAPL, MSFT or BRK-B (up to 50). Every filing found is one result. A symbol that is not in the SEC's company ticker list returns nothing and is not charged.

form.title: Form type
form.description: Optional. Return only this EDGAR form type, for example 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1, DEF 14A or 13F-HR. Leave empty for the most recent filings of any type.

limit_per_ticker.title: Filings per ticker
limit_per_ticker.description: How many of the most recent filings to return for each ticker, 1 to 50. Every filing returned is one charged result.
